text:
kevin: Heads-up — I'm owning the 09:00-10:00 release window tomorrow (deploy train #14). Plan: push runtime v2.3.1 -> model-routing tweak -> canary to eu-west then us-east. I'll run the smoke checklist.
anya: noted. which services are we touching? any db migrations?
kevin: only inference-serving and router. No schema changes. small config toggle in configsvc. No migrations.
jamal: I'll be on standby 09:00-11:00 for rollback if needed. Do you want me to own the rollback play?
sara: +1 to jamal owning rollback. I can take post-smoke verification on APIs (latency & 5xx).
kevin: perfect—jamal you have rollback perms. sara you run quick perf checks: /observability/latency-dashboard + 1m sample.
kevin: smoke run will be:
```
# run from ci-runner (smoke service)
curl -sS -X POST https://smoke.internal/run -d '{"suite":"inference-basic","parallel":5}'
# then tail smoke logs
jq '.results[] | {name:.name,status:.status}' /tmp/smoke-output.json
```
devon: FYI I left a small canary-weight change in the deploy config (10% -> 40% after 5m if no errors). Is that okay?
kevin: yes — plan is: 10% initial, 5m monitor, bump to 40% if all green, then full roll after 15m.
anya: who's calling the green? what metrics threshold?
kevin: green = 0 new 5xx, error rate < 0.1% on canary, p50/p95 under baseline + 20% for first 5m. If breached, rollback.
jamal: adding to runbook: I'll check traces + kubectl rollout status. If rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-dep --to-revision=previous` and notify infra on-call.
ops-bot: Deploy job queued by kevin at 2024-10-15T09:00:00Z — CI build 2487 -> runtime:v2.3.1.
kevin: tagging owners in checklist: @jamal (rollback), @sara (post-smoke), @devon (canary-weight), @anya (release notes).
sara: quick ask — can someone confirm the smoke-runner has access to prod long-term keys? saw an auth failure yesterday but it was transient.
devon: smoke-runner creds were rotated last week, I validated access. ran a dry smoke to prod-staging earlier.
kevin: timeline recap:
- 09:00 start canary -> 10 instances at 10%
- 09:05 basic smoke results
- 09:10 decision point (keep/bump/rollback)
- 09:15 bump to 40% if green
- 09:30 full roll or rollback by 09:40
- 09:45 post-smoke verification done by sara
- 10:00 close out and release notes draft
anya: I can prep the release blurb and changelog in the doc now.
jamal: I'll be on #eng-oncall too. If I trigger rollback I'll ping #incidents and update this thread.
kevin: quick checklist for people:
- jamal: have rollback playbook open and permissions ✅
- sara: dashboards bookmarked ✅
- devon: canary-weight plan in config PR ✅ (PR #4321)
- anya: release notes draft link: https://docs.internal/release/14 (please update)
- kevin: I'll run smoke and post raw logs here
anya: any objections to the canary region order? eu-west first to minimize latency impact for our internal users.
sara: fine by me.
kevin: no objections heard. locking window. If anything changes ping this thread.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Deploy train #14 handoff in 30m.
kevin: thanks team — see you in the window. :thumbsup:
jamal: :eyes:
kevin: (later) smoke-run output: all suites passed 12/12, 0 failures. attaching truncated logs:
```
[smoke] inference-basic: passed (latency p95=210ms, errors=0)
[smoke] router-check: passed (5xx=0)
```
sara: verified dashboards — no spike. p95 steady. marking post-smoke ok.
devon: bumped canary to 40% at 09:15. no regressions.
jamal: watched traces, rollout status ok. no rollback needed.
kevin: full roll started 09:32, completed 09:38. Closing out and pushing release notes. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
